children: SLB signed an agreement to acquire Kelvion for approximately $3.4 billion in cash and will assume about $0.7 billion of debt, expanding its data center thermal management capabilities.
Agreement to acquire Kelvion from Apollo-managed funds and Triton for ~$3.4B cash plus ~$0.7B debt; total value ~11x 2026 EBITDA before synergies.
Kelvion expected 2026 revenue of ~$2.3B–$2.4B and adjusted EBITDA of ~$350M–$400M; data center revenue ~$1.2B–$1.3B.
SLB expects the deal to be accretive to EPS and free cash flow per share within 12 months of closing and to deliver ~$120M annual EBITDA synergies within 3 years.
Transaction expands SLB’s Data Center Solutions, targeting combined 2028 revenue $4.5B–$5B and adjusted EBITDA $700M–$800M for the business.
Deal subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals; expected close in H1 2027.

title: SLB to acquire Kelvion for ~$3.4B cash, assumes $0.7B debt to boost data center thermal capabilities
